# Amsirar Trip

> Private Sahara desert tours, imperial city excursions, and guided Moroccan itineraries.

Amsirar Trip is a licensed local Moroccan travel agency based in Marrakech (License No. 24/TT/RAK). Founded in 2004, the agency operates private Sahara desert tours, Atlas Mountain excursions, and cultural circuits across Morocco.

## Agency details
- Legal entity: Amsirar Trip SARL
- Official license: Agrément Ministère du Tourisme N° 24/TT/RAK (Patente: 45129840, RC Marrakech: 82415)
- Headquarters: Imm. J appt N° 5, Résidence La Perle de l'Atlas, angle Rue aboubakr, Marrakech, Morocco
- Founded: 2004
- Services: Private 4x4 and minivan tours, Erg Chebbi and Erg Chegaga desert camps, camel treks, High Atlas hikes, imperial city circuits, Marrakech day trips
- Languages: English, French (Français), German (Deutsch), Spanish (Español)
- Direct booking and contact:
  - WhatsApp: [+212 661 17 31 44](https://wa.me/212661173144)
  - Official website: [amsirartrip.com](https://amsirartrip.com)
  - Email: [amsirare@gmail.com](mailto:amsirare@gmail.com)

## Core navigation and destinations
- [Home Page](https://amsirartrip.com/): Morocco travel overview, desert expeditions, customer reviews, and trip builder.
- [Tours](https://amsirartrip.com/tours): Multi-day Morocco tours (Merzouga Desert 3-Days, Imperial Cities & Coastline 5-Days, Grand Moroccan Circuit 10-Days).
- [Excursions](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions): Private day excursions from Marrakech (Agafay Desert Sunset, Essaouira Coastal Escape, Ouzoud Waterfalls, Imlil & Toubkal Adventure, Hot Air Balloon).
- [About Us](https://amsirartrip.com/about): Story of Amsirar Trip, licensed local guides, and safety standards.
- [Contact](https://amsirartrip.com/contact): Direct booking inquiries, tailored itineraries, and WhatsApp support.
